title: CIA Mud Bank — Current Desk Balance Snapshot
method: Welfare from exact/override story-entry dates plus explicit event weights and evidence-discounted project-debit amounts from knowledge/cia/mud-bank-contract.json. Dispute/entanglement alone is zero-weight.
boundary: Approximate project accounting only; not money, compensation, objective morality, legal debt, guilt, creditworthiness or human worth.

accounts.note: No sourced debit or credit assigned yet.
The debit prices recovered circulation/repetition only; later reciprocal conflict and current presence remain zero-weight.
Achievement retained as texture rather than moral credit.
Bridge-building remains interpretive; ordinary room-making is documentary.
Growth is a project-symbolic event, not an objective measure.
Historical project-authored debit remains visible; later repair attempt does not erase it.
Proposal is reported through recovered material; outcome unresolved.
Tim's account is the archive operator/root and is not directly comparable to ordinary character sub-ledgers.

interpretation_rules: positive balance means the weighted project ledger currently contains constructive/repair/growth entries; it does not mean a person is morally good.
mixed/disputed means conflict exists but evidence is not strong enough to price as debit or credit.
negative posture requires at least one explicit source-bounded project-debit event; none of the current-desk accounts receives one in this snapshot.
